# 3D Model Info

## Summary
The geometry and provenance facts of a 3D model, across mesh and scene formats.

## Shape
One field spans formats that carry very different amounts: an STL contributes `triangles`,
`vertices`, `solidName` and `dimensions`, while a glTF scene adds `nodes`, `animations`,
`textures`, `materials` and `materialNames`. The 3MF print fields (`plateCount`,
`printPartCount`, `extruderCount`, `hasColorData`) live here too, which is why the taxonomy's
separate STL-mesh and 3MF-package metadata rows have no distinct implementation — they are views
of this one field. `unit` is required to read `dimensions` at all.

## Example
```ts
import { Model3dMetadataField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/metadata-fields';

@field metadata = contains(Model3dMetadataField);
```
